name: Clean Product Film
summary: The airy baseline: real product UI on warm white with soft colour clouds, one coral anomaly row and one human click.
look: Near-white paper, two blurred colour clouds, white cards with soft layered shadows, Instrument Serif headlines with a single teal italic word, and coral reserved for the anomaly and the CTA.

components.name: Colour clouds
components.role: two blurred radial blobs (teal-soft + peach) that grow on the drop; never flat colour backgrounds

components.name: Notification card
components.role: white, r24, soft two-layer shadow, icon tile + bold title + mono meta; the hook’s crowd

components.name: Product window
components.role: one real-looking UI panel with a live dot; rows with sparklines = the proof surface

components.name: Anomaly row
components.role: coral left rule + tinted fill, mono “since · after” context line, primary + secondary action

components.name: Serif headline
components.role: Instrument Serif 76–108 px, exactly one italic teal word per frame

components.name: Coral pill CTA
components.role: the only solid coral object in the film besides the anomaly — pain and action share a colour

motion.name: Per-word headline
motion.how: each word rises 24 px + fades, power3.out 0.35 s, one word per eighth-note (0.25 s at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Beat-stagger cards
motion.how: cards slide 60 px from alternating edges with 2–3° rotation, back.out(1.2) 0.5 s, one per beat (0.5 s)

motion.name: Zoom-through seam
motion.how: camera scales 0.6→1 into the window over one bar (2 s), expo.inOut; rows then fill one per beat and the anomaly lands on a bar downbeat

story: Hook: notification cards about 38 open dashboards swarm around the question. Reveal: the frame clears on the drop and “You ship. Pulse watches.” resolves into the Acme Pulse lockup. Proof: the Pulse window fills with healthy metrics until Checkout conversion −18% (since 09:42, after deploy #2231) turns coral and a cursor clicks Roll back. CTA: calm lockup, “Every metric. Every minute.” and a coral Start free pill.
adapt: Swap the metric rows for your own product’s core list (tickets, invoices, builds, deals) and keep one row as the “problem” row with a context line and a single primary action. The cards in the hook are simply your users’ current tools and alerts.

references.note: emphasized easing and duration scaled to distance
calm, low-noise product UI as the hero

fit.risk: Can feel generic; needs precise beat cuts and quality shadows/type to feel premium.
